scope: AOSP public SDK/Binder/AIDL/permission source discovery; original release source inventory remains immutable

classification_rules.relevant: Pinned complete tree contains at least one declared source-kind path; matching paths enumerated in full
classification_rules.irrelevant: Pinned tree is empty, so it contains no source entries
classification_rules.unknown: Tree unavailable/uninspected, or no declared-kind match while native/generated/other Binder sources cannot be ruled out; version2 adds filename-only discovery dimensions without treating absence of signals as irrelevance

reason_codebook: Complete tree has no declared-kind match; native, generated or other Binder/interface sources remain unexcluded
Complete pinned tree contains declared source kinds; all matching paths enumerated
